title: Waiting for the Right Moment
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Queen Esther, brave and also wise,
Did not rush in too soon.
She asked the king and Haman both
To eat that afternoon.

[Chorus]
Heavenly Father helps you wait
Until the time is right.
For patient hearts are wise and good,
And good things come to light.

[Verse 2]
"What would you like?" the king then asked,
"I'll give you anything!"
But Esther waited, kind and calm:
"Come dine again, my king."

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, and wait for sleep
Beneath the quiet moon.
God helps you learn to wait for things;
The right time's coming soon.

[Chorus]
mood: Patient music. A slow, unhurried pulse rocks beneath the voice, never rushing, like a wise queen waiting for just the right moment to speak. The chorus is warm and steady, content to wait. By the last verse the rocking slows further and drops lower, the waiting turned into trust, and the song settles gently as sleep comes.
